d: Long, flowing crimson hair with straight bangs and a deep burgundy gradient at the ends flows behind an adolescent face with sharp, narrow emerald green eyes. A slender build is dressed in a white crop top, a short black pleated skirt with a white and red utility belt, and a loose black-and-red oversized jacket draped over the shoulders, paired with asymmetrical black-and-white thigh-high stockings. Two large, curved dark-maroon horns protrude from the head, complemented by a black choker and a large, grey metallic monolith-like weapon held in the hand.
